notes.title: Second update - further balancing and some fixes
notes.notes:
Hello dear Metroloopers!  Second update brings changes to difficulty balance as well as it fixes some issues related with two enemies behaviour. Here is the list of all changes:

Changes to weapons specs, increased accuracy of pistol, shotgun and machine gun among others

Difficulty curve related to amount of monsters on each station was changed in a way that it makes it easier on the begining and thougher further down the metro line

Fixed wasp and wolf AI that was stopping them at some point during game

Minor changes to other enemies parameters



THE NEXT STOP IS HELL - SEE YOU THERE!

notes.title: First update now available!
notes.notes:
Hello Metroloopers!

The following changes took place in this first update after receiving initial feedback:

 Minor changes to balance of the game, especially initial stations
 Added killed monsters counter in the pause menu
 Version number added in main menu
 Possibility of exploiting previous save system to gain a lot of loot without going through stations was removed


Please note:
Now, after resuming to the game you will have to pass at least one more station, before you can leave the game with saving.

I wish you happy survival and many stations passed safely!
Wacky Coati
